qui etiam secundo de Natura Deorum: Audia-

scio, & quem ex tuo ore admiror, quam cum istis
vera sentire. Verum pro Cicerone, & omnibus
aliis licet judicibus integerrimis, prodeat unus
Augustinus qui pluribus quidem in locis, sed libro
tertio contra cAademicos sic in ejus fertur enco-

temporum suorum, qui & ita locutus est, ut qua-
ecunque diceret, magna fierent, & ea locutus est,
ut quomodocunque diceret, parva non fierent,

page.notes: Long s normalised to plain s throughout (e.g. "stomachum", "fentias", "fuorum" read as "suorum"). "cAademicos" is as printed, apparently a stray letter for "Academicos" (printing error, left as printed). "Myfta" is as printed; probably "Mysta" in the original spelling, left as printed. The closing bracket after "admiror" in the scan is a stray mark and was not transcribed. The top line is the end of a paragraph from the previous page. No running head is printed.
